_comment: All dimensions in mm. Positions number left-to-right, top-to-bottom, starting at 1. 'source' must cite where the margins and gaps came from (vendor template PDF). A target with cols*rows == 1 and label == page is a single-label medium (thermal roll); rotation by 90 degrees is permitted only for those.

sheets.name: Label Planet LP4/99, Avery L7169 (A4, 4 per sheet, 99.1 x 139 mm)
sheets.source: Label Planet LP4/99 template specification (https://www.labelplanet.co.uk/label-templates-for-rounded-rectangle-labels/label-templates-4-per-sheet-lp4-99/): top margin 9.5mm, bottom margin 9.5mm, left margin 4.65mm, right margin 4.65mm, horizontal pitch 101.6mm, vertical pitch 139mm (label height, so no vertical gap). gapX = 101.6 - 99.1 = 2.5mm. Sanity check: 2*4.65 + 2*99.1 + 2.5 = 210.0mm exactly; 2*9.5 + 2*139 = 297.0mm exactly. Avery's own L7169 template page (avery.co.uk/template-l7169) is behind a Cloudflare challenge and could not be fetched (403 on every attempt, including a browser user agent); a third-party (glabels/pdf-labels project) Avery template file gives x0=14.2pt(~5.0mm)/y0=20pt(~7.1mm), which does not sanity-check against the A4 page (off by ~4.9mm vertically) and was discarded in favour of Label Planet's directly-quoted, self-consistent figures.

sheets.name: Label Planet LP4/105 (A4, 4 per sheet, 105 x 148.5 mm, no margins)
sheets.source: Label Planet LP4/105 template specification (https://www.labelplanet.co.uk/label-templates-for-square-cut-rectangle-labels/label-templates-4-per-sheet-lp4-105/): top/bottom/left/right margin 0mm, horizontal pitch 105mm and vertical pitch 148.5mm (both equal to the label size, so no gaps). Confirms the zero-margin, zero-gap A4-quartered assumption exactly.

sheets.name: Avery L7168 (A4, 2 per sheet, 199.6 x 143.5 mm)
sheets.source: Avery's own L7168 template page (avery.co.uk/template-l7168) is behind a Cloudflare challenge and could not be fetched. Label Planet LP2/199, the same 199.6 x 143.5mm 2-per-sheet size (https://www.labelplanet.co.uk/label-templates-for-rounded-rectangle-labels/label-templates-2-per-sheet-lp2-199/): top margin 5mm, bottom margin 5mm, left margin 5.2mm, right margin 5.2mm, horizontal pitch 199.6mm and vertical pitch 143.5mm (both equal to the label size, no gaps; page states 'no gaps between labels'). These happen to equal the original evenly-divided sanity figures. Sanity check: 2*5.2 + 199.6 = 210.0mm exactly; 2*5 + 2*143.5 = 297.0mm exactly.

sheets.name: 4 x 6 in thermal label (101.6 x 152.4 mm, one label per page)
sheets.source: By definition: 4 x 6 in = 101.6 x 152.4 mm = 288 x 432 pt. Media box is the whole label; no printer margin, no bleed.
